roles.assertion: R4A uses real bounded Rust threads, but remains a nonlinked test research witness
roles.concern: Do not imply new native scheduler or runtime ABI in certified kernel

roles.assertion: R4M tests two genuinely ad-hoc signed peers with equal IDs and distinct CDHash on macOS
roles.concern: Local ad-hoc signatures do not establish production signer trust or independent custody

roles.assertion: Real distinct processes and two keys can remain within the same administrator UID
roles.concern: Cryptographic signatures or distinct PID are not independent operator control

roles.assertion: R6E checks candidate public-key SHA and verifies sixth SSHSIG using caller-supplied local_allowed, without checking allowed_signers contains only that pinned key
roles.concern: Actual rogue Ed25519 signer permitted by a substituted allowed_signers file can trigger legacy six-local-signer success wording

roles.assertion: Frozen R6B–R6E owner replay PENDING snapshots predates later owner terminal evidence
roles.concern: Historical source and later owner observations must remain separate; CI is not external custody

roles.assertion: Original policy preserves all twelve unmet native external-admission gates
roles.concern: No proof of owner-authenticated OOB root, independent guardian or global monotonic antirollback

roles.assertion: Real coherent same-admin rollback can restore local state to an older consistent snapshot
roles.concern: A local signed log, key alias or namespace is not an independent nonrollbackable history

roles.assertion: Previous R6E local signature tests did not include a genuine unpinned key substituted through local_allowed
roles.concern: Green 1111 owner tests did not exercise this specific signer attribution contradiction

roles.assertion: Static governance blocks certification, native admission and production from editable local files
roles.concern: Nine coordinated source viewpoints cannot be represented as nine independently executed agent attestations

findings.description: Public key pin checked independently of allowed_signers used to verify sixth SSHSIG
findings.reproducer: Two real same-admin Ed25519 keys plus a third rogue key; replace only local_allowed and local_signature while retaining local_public; legacy R6E reports SIX_VALID_LOCAL_SIGNATURES, always denial
findings.correction: Additive R3 exact single-identity ED25519 allowed_signers-to-public-key binding before running inherited signed chain; reject rogue key while retaining no native grant

findings.description: Coherent restored local nonce/revocation/history is untrusted as independent global monotonic custody
Real signed XPC/CDHash cases use local ad-hoc identities, not an independent production root
Staged local log sha256 verifies bytes but not author identity or actual independent specialist execution
Additive local allowlist validation and FD snapshot checks remain same-admin local observations; not security against adversary who controls all file content and scheduling
